label: Git Delivery Pro
summary: Repository-driven delivery workflows with versioned branch/tag policy, isolated builds, immutable artifact references, environment binding and deployment history. Provider-specific authentication and webhooks remain separately selected connectors.
core_boundary: Core owns sites, current authorization, admitted deployment effects, secrets and durable jobs. Git Delivery adds optional repository and pipeline orchestration; repository content cannot register privileged commands or modify the Core dependency graph.
acceptance: Bind repository identity, permitted revisions and destination resources explicitly; refuse arbitrary URL schemes, paths and changed trust.
Treat builds and dependency resolution as untrusted non-root work with isolated workspaces, bounded resources and no panel/agent secrets.
Verify artifact identity and provenance before passing an immutable reference to an admitted deployment operation.
Test trigger replay, concurrent pushes, stale resource revisions and missing acknowledgements without duplicate deployment effects.
Keep the last deployed release serving after connector or module failure; retain history and supported recovery references.
